newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Shares in Portugal's Lisnave suspended.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Portugal's Lisnave suspended.

text.p: Trade in Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave was suspended on the Lisbon bourse by the Financial Markets Committee (CMVM), dealers said.
Reasons for the suspension were not immediately known and CMVM officials were not available.
Diario Economico newspaper reported today that the government had agreed on Friday to provide Lisnave with a guarantee of four billion escudos under a restructuring plan for the company.
